title: Get found on Google
content:
## What you'll get

Once you publish your app, you'll want people to actually find it. This short guide walks you through the basics of search engine optimization (SEO) so your app can start appearing in Google results.

## What SEO is (and why it matters)

SEO stands for "search engine optimization" - the practice of making your app easier for Google and other search engines to understand and show to searchers. When done right, someone searching for what your app does can discover it organically, without you paying for ads.

## Optimizing your app for search

Search engines look at your page titles, descriptions, and content to decide what your app is about. Clear, descriptive text helps both people and Google understand what you've built.

## Verifying with Google Search Console

<Callout type="warning" title="Draft - needs review">
This section needs product confirmation: Does Emergent support Google Search Console verification (e.g., by letting users add a meta tag or upload a verification file)? If so, describe the exact steps in the Emergent UI. If not, state that explicitly.
</Callout>

Google Search Console is a free tool that shows you how your site appears in search results and flags any issues Google encounters when crawling your pages.

## Setting realistic expectations

SEO takes time. Google typically needs a few weeks (sometimes longer) to discover your site, understand it, and start ranking it for relevant searches. You won't see traffic overnight, and that's completely normal - even for large companies launching new pages.

<Callout type="tip" title="Patience pays off">
Focus on building something genuinely useful. Quality content and a good user experience are the best long-term SEO strategies.
</Callout>
